summary: John's 10th-great-grandfather; Southold landowner whose children's births are in his family Bible.
bio: Southold landowner; his children's births are recorded in his family Bible (Akerly). WikiTree's 'born Tharston' is uncertain; Akerly says 'in England?', and the Hingham records point to a birth there. After his father's death his mother Bridget married William Wells, who became guardian of the Tuthill children; his son John Jr. later married Wells's daughter Mehitable. Henry Tuthill 'the Justice' (b. 1665), who married Bethia Horton, granddaughter of William Wells, and was great-great-grandfather of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison, is placed in this family by the relationship math (Anna is 4C7R via Tuthill). Wife not named in project files; the deep-dive report mentions 'Tuthill, King and Wells relationships' and Round 3 'Browne/King' ancestors, which suggests a King wife somewhere in this branch (not specified).
